title: FlowRecord
description: One captured network flow. Capture emits it on the Redis flows channel; the ml-service consumes it. Capture stays dumb: features holds the raw CICFlowMeter fields under their emitted names, and the featurizer (ml-service) owns all renaming and cleaning. Contract shape from spec 0001 Feature design.

schema_version.description: Contract version. A breaking change bumps it (spec 0001 key invariants).

flow_id.description: Unique id for this flow. The verdict echoes it back.

dst_port.description: Destination port (part of the 5 tuple). Must equal features.destination_port.

protocol.description: IP protocol number (part of the 5 tuple), for example 6 for TCP or 17 for UDP.

features.description: The raw CICFlowMeter fields under their emitted names. The featurizer reads and cleans these into the 67 feature vector. Extra fields are allowed so capture stays dumb; destination_port is required and must equal dst_port.

destination_port.description: Raw destination port. The featurizer buckets on this and cross checks it against the top level dst_port.

ground_truth.description: The true label when replaying labeled CICIDS data (for the metrics slice). Null for live capture.
